THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER 1.
Both the petitioners and respondent No.2 and also their respective counsel are present before the Court.
2. The parties have filed an application under Section 320(6) of Cr.P.C praying this Court to compound the offence on the ground that the offences are basically private and personal in nature.
Joint affidavit is also field NC: 2024:KHC:6445 by both the husband and wife.

Both of them are amicably settled the dispute in M.C.No.5084/2021.
3.

The parties have also filed joint memo, in view of the settlement arrived between the husband and wife and also the settlement arrived between the parties and the offences Section 498A, 506 of IPC and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act are compoundable in nature and arising out of Crime No. 60/2020 and the same is registerd as C.C.No.39642/2022.
4.
The parties are permitted to compound the offences.
